description: Cpeak for Rust is an HTTP framework on hyper with one single-threaded Tokio event loop per core. Default configuration: routing, path and query parameters through the Cpeak API, JSON through res.json() (sonic-rs), Cpeak's built-in compression (gzip or brotli, per request), cpeak::sleep() for the waits and Cpeak's https option (rustls) for TLS.
